blocks.h2: What a Maintenance Visit Can (and Can't) Fix
blocks.intro: A maintenance visit is built around prevention, not repair. Here's where the line falls:
head: Included in a Maintenance Visit
Needs a Different Service
rows: A camera inspection to check your line's current condition
An active sewage backup. Likely fix: [Emergency Plumbing](/chicago-ravenswood/emergency-plumbing)
Catching early root growth or wear before it becomes a bigger problem
A cracked or collapsed pipe. Likely fix: [Sewer Repair](/chicago-ravenswood/sewer-repair)
A light interior clean as part of the visit
A heavy clog that needs full clearing. Likely fix: [Sewer Rodding](/chicago-ravenswood/sewer-rodding) or [Hydro Jetting](/chicago-ravenswood/hydro-jetting)
An honest assessment of what your line needs next
A line at the end of its lifespan. Likely fix: [Trenchless Sewer Repair](/chicago-ravenswood/trenchless-sewer-repair)
blocks.note: If your line needs more than a checkup, we'll tell you exactly what and why. No surprise upsells.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Sewer Maintenance
blocks.body: Rodding is the simplest visit. Jetting takes more time and equipment. A camera check adds a few minutes and a lot of information. Access to the cleanout matters too. We quote a flat price for each visit.

blocks.h2: Sewer Maintenance Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: Should two-flat owners schedule sewer maintenance?
items.preview: If the line has a history, yes.
items.answer: If it's had roots or backups, yes. It protects the garden unit.
Late winter or early spring, before roots grow and storms arrive.

items.preview: It helps, but protection does more.
items.answer: A clean line drains better. When the city sewer is full, a backflow valve or overhead sewer is what keeps water out.

items.q: Is maintenance part of the No Drip Club?
items.preview: The club includes regular maintenance visits.
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) includes regular maintenance visits for homeowners.

items.q: Should the building have one schedule for all units?
items.answer: Yes. The lateral is shared, so one schedule covers everyone.

items.q: How much does sewer maintenance cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the service. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether the line needs rodding, jetting or a camera check. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
